canonical_name: Incredible Business Networking (IBN) - Brevard/Pisgah Forest chapter
summary: IBN Biz Lunch is a free monthly business-networking lunch run by Incredible Towns of WNC, a regional media/events company that hosts near-identical IBN lunches at many WNC locations (Asheville east/west, Candler, Hendersonville, Brevard/Pisgah Forest, etc.), funded by sponsor businesses like Mr. Rooter Plumbing. The Brevard/Pisgah Forest edition meets the second Thursday monthly at Hawg Wild Smokehouse & Taproom. Every listing and the organizer's own site emphasize no membership, no dues, no attendance requirements, and an explicitly rotating/open model meant to keep welcoming new participants rather than a fixed roster of regulars.

evidence.note: Listing describes it as 'a free business networking lunch event open to all, with no membership or attendance requirements,' repeated verbatim across all 11 monthly listings.
Tags on every listing include 'No Membership Required,' 'Open To All,' 'Walk Ins Welcome,' and 'Drop In Event' - the organizer's own framing, not just a scraper artifact.

Organizer's own page states the page 'emphasizes an open, rotating model rather than a closed membership' with 'no attendance requirements, fees, dues or exclusions,' explicitly designed to continuously welcome new participants.

IBN is run as a multi-chapter program by Incredible Towns of WNC across many WNC towns simultaneously (Asheville East, Asheville West, Candler, Brevard, etc.), i.e. a franchised commercial networking product rather than one organic community.
Search found no independent Facebook group, Meetup, or membership roster for the Brevard/Pisgah Forest chapter specifically - only event listings and the parent organizer's marketing pages.
